subject: POC engagement sprint: kickoff, success hypotheses, weekly syncs
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodai.com>
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@quantive.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@quantive.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC engagement sprint: kickoff, success hypotheses, weekly syncs

Hi Liam / Priya —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single source of truth before scheduling the kickoff: 

What we heard (high level)
- Priority use case: automated claims triage + summarization for first-line review (focus on accuracy for adverse event detection).
- Target metric: recall on PII/red-flag detection > 95% for sampled claims set; summary usefulness score (stakeholder-rated) >= 4/5.
- Constraints: no PHI transit to public endpoints; Quantive needs audit logs for inference requests and 90-day test data residency in us-east-1.

Proposed POC scope and timeline (anchor)
- Week 0 (prep, 1 week): provision dedicated test tenant, sample dataset ingest, minimal schema mapping.
- Weeks 1–3 (sprint): run 3 evaluation passes — baseline, tuned prompts, quantized model variant. Weekly readouts on Friday.
- Week 4 (final readout): decision meeting with success rubric and handoff plan.

Success hypotheses (we'll measure these):
1) System achieves >=95% recall on flagged claims in evaluation set.
2) Average summary usefulness >=4/5 from triage reviewers (n=10).
3) End-to-end latency for a single-claim flow under 1.2s (90th percentile).

Ownership (proposed)
- Quantive: dataset steward (Liam), clinical SME (Priya)
- Redwood: POC lead (Hannah), infra/test tenant (Marissa), model tuning & instrumentation (Ben)

Immediate asks
1) Can you confirm the dataset sampling approach and whether we can get a 2k-record anonymized sample by next Tue (2025-10-14)?
2) Any procurement/NDAs required before we spin up the test tenant? If so, share the contact.
3) Confirm preferred kickoff week: Oct 20 or Oct 27 — we can accommodate either.

Attachments: POC-Scope-v1.pdf (scope + rubric), MutualActionPlan-quantive.xlsx (owners & dates).

If that looks good I'll: (a) book a 30-min internal pre-kickoff with our team, (b) schedule the kickoff invite with your calendar once you confirm the week.

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodai.com | +1 415-555-0192
Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@quantive.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@quantive.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Oct 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC engagement sprint: kickoff, success hypotheses, weekly syncs

Thanks Hannah — this is really helpful and aligns with what our ops team captured. A few notes: 

- We can produce a 2k anonymized sample by Tue 14 Oct, but it will be stripped of direct identifiers in-house (no PHI leaves our environment). I'll attach the extraction spec in a follow-up; you can treat the sample as "redacted" for provisioning.
- Procurement: we'll need an MSA + a one-page DPA before provisioning. I'll push through the legal request today; timeline is typically 3–5 business days but we can expedite if needed.
- Kickoff: Oct 27 would be safer for internal stakeholder availability (we have an internal audit on Oct 21–23).

One more ask from our side: can Redwood capture per-request trace IDs in logs (so we can map model output back to our records)? This is critical for our QA process.

We'll confirm the exact extract format by EOD Tue. Looking forward —

—Liam
Liam O'Neill
Head of Automation, Quantive
liam.oneill@quantive.com | +1 917-555-0224

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodai.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodai.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Oct 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: POC engagement sprint: kickoff, success hypotheses, weekly syncs

Folks — forwarding Liam's confirmation. Two internal asks before I schedule the kickoff for week of Oct 27: 

1) Marissa — can you provision a dedicated test tenant in us-east-1 with 90-day log retention and enable request-level trace IDs? We need this ready by Oct 24 so we have one week to smoke test.
2) Ben — can you prepare a short evaluation harness and agree on the sampling/checklist we'll use for the 3 evaluation passes? I marked the success hypotheses above — we need a reproducible script for the recall checks and a small rubric for the reviewer usefulness survey.
3) Jonas — can you be backup for Marissa on infra and own the Friday readout slides if Marissa is tied up?

Quick internal cadence: 30-min prep on Oct 23 (review tenant + harness), kickoff on Oct 27 (60 min), weekly 30-min readouts on Fridays (Oct 31, Nov 7, Nov 14), final readout week of Nov 17.

CC: @Marissa, @Ben, @Jonas — if you see schedule conflicts call them out today. I also attached the proposed MutualActionPlan-quantive.xlsx with owners and provisional dates.

Hannah

All good from my side — I can own the evaluation harness and the recall scripts. A couple of notes / risks to flag: 

- Data access: if Quantive cannot provide a redacted sample that includes the claim status labels we'll need a short annotation sprint on our side; that would add one week. Please confirm whether labels are included in the 2k extract.
- Telemetry: I will instrument per-request trace IDs and a minimal observability dashboard (latency, token counts, model variant, trace_id). Marissa — I'll need a service account and read access to the tenant logs by Oct 23.
- Security/compliance: if Legal requires an on-prem execution or HSM-backed key handling we should surface costs early. Jonas — can you help capture a delta estimate if we need to move to a private deployment?

I'll set up a short internal runbook doc and add links to the harness once it's ready — target EOD Oct 21 for a first commit.

Ben
